_provenance: Coordinates for S1/M1 and all ISUSM entries come from the live IEM geojson/network/ISUSM.geojson endpoint (verified 2026-09-01). ICN codes and names were scraped live from warm.isws.illinois.edu/warm/climnet/stnmetadata.asp on the same date. ICN lat/lon are NOT included: they are not machine-readable on the public station pages and were not invented. Radar coordinates were read from the KDVN Level II volume header. Ranges/azimuths computed with pyproj Geod(ellps='WGS84'). ATMOS coordinates come from the AmeriFlux site registry (SITE_ID US-AMS, verified 2026-09-28); the CHICAGO entry is a city centroid and is NOT a tower location.

domain.note: lon_min,lat_min,lon_max,lat_max. Ames IA (west) to Chicago IL (east) land-use gradient.

S1.name: Muscatine Island Research Farm (MIRF), Iowa State University

M1.name: South East Research Farm (SERF), Iowa State University

NIU.name: Northern Illinois University, DeKalb IL (Argonne Deployable Mast)

ATMOS.name: Argonne Testbed for Multiscale Observational Science (ATMOS), Argonne National Laboratory campus, Lemont IL
ATMOS.coord_source: AmeriFlux site registry, SITE_ID US-AMS (amfcdn.lbl.gov/api/v1/site_display/AmeriFlux, verified 2026-09-28)
ATMOS.note: Only 13 km from KLOT, so it sits deep inside that radar's good-coverage annulus - useful as a ground-truth anchor for radar work, but at that range a constant-altitude product above ~4 km is in the cone of silence. Distinct from the CHICAGO entry below, which is a city centroid ~35 km NE.

CHICAGO.name: Chicago region centroid (CROCUS Chicago Micronet footprint; NOT the ATMOS tower - see the ATMOS entry above)

KDVN.name: Davenport IA WSR-88D
KDVN.note: S1 and M1 both lie on azimuth 238.7 deg from here, at 54.4 and 88.7 km. NWS DVN launches the 00Z/12Z soundings.

FRUI4: Fruitland - Muscatine Island ISU-RDF (= DERECHOS S1)
